question: Ở Việt Nam hiện nay con tôi có quyền được can thiệp sớm miễn phí bắt buộc theo luật không?

retrieved_sources.title: Autism in Viet Nam: A systematic scoping review

gioi_han: 137-study scoping review; 87% conducted in Vietnam, others in diaspora contexts; underlying studies largely low quality.
Research perceptions of causes are not established causes of ASD. Historical legal/service statements require current primary Vietnamese verification.

PRISMA figure has internal count discrepancies (274 + 3688 differs from 3960; displayed database subtotals differ from displayed total). Preserve originals; do not silently reconcile or treat flow counts as verified quantitative evidence.
Supplement MMAT chart counts are criterion ratings, not independent study counts.
Source/provenance review only; no independent clinical appraisal.
Retain actual ages, geography and study limitations; no individualized diagnosis, treatment or dosing inference.

source.ten_nguon: Journal of Autism and Developmental Disorders

gioi_han: Foundational 2015 description of NDBIs, not a current professional practice guideline or a head-to-head trial.
Intervention choices and goals must be individualized; no guaranteed language gain, cure or fixed intensity for all children.
Reviews/program descriptions can overlap underlying studies; not independent replication.
No independent clinical review; research/internal noncommercial use, no individual diagnosis or prescription.
